notes: Nine completed localized interaction episodes are visible. The pantry has two independently movable door leaves; their opening and closing actions occur within short, partially occluded intervals, so they are retained as separate lower-confidence events. The bedroom entry door is opened near frame 1480 but no clearly supported closing manipulation is visible, so it is not reported as a completed on/off episode.
scene_description: A first-person traversal through an apartment kitchen, living area, utility and laundry closets, and a bedroom. Interactions consist primarily of opening objects, inspecting their interiors, and closing them.
